name: esspr_data4train
description:
Here is the training data for paper:"Unified Vision-Language Representation Modeling for E-Commerce Same-Style Products Retrieval". (Accepted in WWW2023 Industry track).
All the data are the same with those for the experiments of esspr. 
The data format is formulated as: 'cate_lv1_name,cate_name,trigger_id,tirgger_title,recall_id,recall_title,trigger_img,recall_img,label'
All the image and title for each items are online grapped, with only id_value is virtual, in order to protect privacy.
